title: Dependency map viewport
responsibility: Calculates map fitting, zoom, panning, visible edges and directional keyboard navigation.

inputs.name: focusOn.layout
inputs.description: Layout to consider for automatic focus.

inputs.name: zoomView.factor
inputs.description: Zoom factor dividing the viewport width.

inputs.name: zoomView.whole
inputs.description: Whole-map bounds used for the maximum zoom-out width.

inputs.name: drawnEdges.layout
inputs.description: Layout whose edges may be drawn.

outputs.name: wholeView
outputs.description: Whole layout with 24 units of padding on every side.

outputs.name: focusView
outputs.description: Bounds of requested nodes with at least about four cells of context in each dimension; returns the whole view for none or all of the nodes.

outputs.name: focusOn
outputs.description: Focused bounds only for maps above 60 nodes; otherwise null.

outputs.name: zoomView
outputs.description: Centered zoom preserving aspect ratio, clamped between two node widths and 1.5 whole-map widths.

outputs.name: panView
outputs.description: Viewport translated by the supplied offsets without changing size.

outputs.name: drawnEdges
outputs.description: All edges for at most 60 nodes; otherwise only edges touching the selection.

outputs.name: nextNode
outputs.description: Nearest eligible node ahead, minimizing along-axis distance plus four times sideways distance; stays at the current node when none is ahead, and returns undefined for an unknown origin or non-arrow key.
